request: Casting an ability takes twice its listed mana cost. A successful cast should charge the listed cost once; a rejected cooldown recast must not spend more mana or extend its cooldown. Reproduce and fix this using actual arena casts.
analysis: ChampionKit lists Morgana E at 70 mana with a 14-second base cooldown. DexArena.Cast calls Combat.BeginCast, whose mana deduction currently multiplies the listed cost by two. This is a suspected cause pending actual arena execution. The scenario checks a successful shield cast, ordinary regeneration, and a cooldown rejection after time has elapsed.

reviewReason: The report explicitly requires one listed mana charge per successful cast and no additional mana charge or cooldown extension on a rejected recast. ChampionKit lists Morgana E at 70 mana and 14 seconds; DexArena.Cast calls BeginCast, whose original deduction is twice the listed cost. The trace reproduces a 140-mana deduction while confirming a successful shield cast. Retain success and active-cooldown controls alongside the report-derived resource assertions. These checks cover this cast and recast, not every ability.

Remove that multiplier in the shared cast gate; rejection checks and cooldown assignment remain unchanged. Host verification of the proposed repair is pending.

scenario.expectedBehavior: Morgana E grants a shield, spends 70 mana once, and starts its 14-second cooldown at zero haste. After 0.5 seconds, ordinary regeneration restores 3 mana. A cooldown recast preserves mana, the original readiness deadline, and the shield lifetime. The idle opponent retains its mana.
